title: implement searching in facet values
body:
For long list of facet values, it would be cool to have an option like "valuesSearchBox: true" that would display a searchbox and do the necessary heavy lifting on the helper to display corresponding "current filters + user facet value query" facet values.

This would require the user to have a custom facet values index.

It may not be that efficient to pass long list of filters to the API but we have to try.

cc @pixelastic @gregquat
